world.why_this_world: The mechanism is record ASSEMBLY, so the set is the assembler: intake, count and both outputs are three features of one machine face, which puts the whole allegation in one frame and means the film never travels.

the_turn.what_gets_worse: The count stops being a number on a wheel and becomes the floor. The copies fan out until the cast is standing on them, so the quantity is measured against their own bodies instead of against a digit.
